## ✨ What's new

Ember 0.2 is about folder sync. Whether a folder uploads **New files only** or **Everything here** used to be fixed when you added it. Getting a folder's older files later meant removing it and adding it again, which made Ember forget what it had uploaded, so those files went up a second time. Now you can switch whenever you like, and big backlogs behave better too.

- **Upload what was already there.** Tap a folder in **Sync** and choose **Everything here** under **Which files upload**, which used to be **Start with** and only appeared when adding a folder. Ember asks first, then uploads the files that were there before you added the folder, oldest first. Files this folder already uploaded aren't sent again.
- **Switch back any time.** Choosing **New files only** again stops the older files Ember hasn't started yet, before the next file. One that's already underway, like a long video that's partly sent, still finishes. The folder shows when **New files only** counts from and how many files are waiting.
- **New files go first.** Ember uploads a backlog in stretches, and new files used to wait for all of it. Now they go ahead of older files once the current stretch ends, usually within 8 minutes, or 30 while Ember is open.
- **Quiet backlogs.** Older files don't copy their links or notify one by one, so **Everything here** on Screenshots won't replace your clipboard with every old screenshot. Ember sends a summary notification instead.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Syncs you start keep going.** After the first stretch, **Sync now** and adding a folder stopped for good while **Automatic sync** was off, and otherwise waited for a charger with **Only while charging** on, or while the battery was low. Syncs you start, including **Everything here**, now keep going until they're done, and still respect **Wi-Fi only**.
- **A photo taken right as you add a folder counts as new.** Android's media library stores whole seconds, so **New files only** skipped a photo from that same second.

## ⬆️ Updating

Install it over 0.1.0. Your connection, folders, and upload history stay, and every folder keeps its current choice until you change it.

The [folder sync guide](https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/blob/v0.2.0/docs/sync.md#upload-what-was-already-there) covers the new option. [Full changelog: v0.1.0 → v0.2.0](https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0)

## 📲 Install

Download `Ember-0.2.0.apk` below and open it on your phone (Android 8.0 or newer). New to Ember? The [getting started guide](https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/blob/v0.2.0/docs/getting-started.md) walks through creating a token and connecting, including servers on your home network.

To check the download, compare it with `SHA256SUMS`. The APK is signed with the same certificate as 0.1.0:

```text
SHA-256: 99:0D:09:8E:FE:E3:7E:AB:6D:28:6D:75:2D:F8:CD:17:F1:46:EF:9E:14:E5:00:1A:F3:C4:E1:F1:00:81:86:9B
```

Want to try what's next before it's released? **Ember Rolling** is built from every change merged to `main` and installs next to the stable app. Find it under the [`rolling` pre-release](https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/releases/tag/rolling).

Suggestions and bug reports are very welcome, in [issues](https://github.com/FlintSH/Ember/issues) or the [Flare Discord](https://discord.gg/mwVAjKwPus).
